rows.grounds: compound of ādi, anta, and ga; describes the extent of the noose
compound of mahā and pāśa; subject of the declaration
adjective qualifying mahāpāśaḥ as of human origin
past passive participle indicating what is proclaimed

items.question: What extent and origin are attributed to the great noose in this Śākta array?
premises: The great noose is described as reaching beginning and end.
The great noose is characterized as human-derived.
items.inference: The great noose spanning beginning and end is proclaimed to be of human origin.
uncertainties: The precise referent of beginning and end in this ritual context is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: The great noose, reaching from beginning to end, is declared to be of human origin.
